2026-07-09: Added a `variant?: 'gated' | 'immediate'` prop (default `'gated'`, preserving Contents/Manuscript-stage behavior unchanged). `'immediate'` (used only by WriteTool) makes the textarea editable the instant a produced chapter mounts — no 'Edit Text'/'Edit Anyway' click-through — and swaps the produced-chapter strip for a new calm `chapter-text-panel__info-banner` ('Editing the full source. Committing re-syncs voice assignments — you'll preview what's kept before anything changes.') instead of the alarming warning-tint strip. Added a Discard button beside Commit Changes in the footer (`handleDiscard` resets text to `chapterText.chapter.text_content` and, for the gated variant, re-locks back to read-only); both buttons disabled when there are no uncommitted changes or a resync/commit is in flight. Added `eyebrowLabel()` mapping the raw `ChapterLifecycle` enum to consequence-aware wording for this surface only (Rendered->'Audio rendered', Cast->'Audio in progress' [Cast is actually the in-progress/partial state per deriveChapterLifecycle], Stale->'Needs re-render', Error->'Render error', Draft/Ready unchanged) — ChapterTable's status pill keeps the raw enum, untouched. Copy sweep (voice-tone.md): 'Edit text'/'Edit anyway'/'Commit changes' -> Title Case; 'saving...'/'Start typing...' -> '…'; 'editing - autosaved' -> em dash; 'autosave failed' -> sentence case; spaced-hyphen in the warning copy -> em dash; renamed the misleading 'Assignment-safe edit mode' strip to 'Changes aren't saved until you commit them.' (kept for the gated variant only).

2026-07-10: Added optional `onDirtyChange?: (dirty: boolean) => void` prop. A new effect calls it whenever `chapterText.isProduced && chapterText.hasTextChanges` changes — the existing `useChapterText` signal for "produced chapter has an uncommitted edit not yet pushed through the resync/commit flow" (non-produced chapters autosave, so they never report dirty here). No new state was added; this just surfaces an existing derived value.

exports.name: deriveChapterLifecycle, ChapterLifecycle
exports.contract: Chapter -> ChapterLifecycle. ChapterLifecycle union gained 'Stale' and 'Error'. deriveChapterLifecycle checks audio_status==="error"/"failed" first (-> Error), then text_last_modified > audio_generated_at (-> Stale), before falling into the Rendered/Cast/Ready/Draft chain — mirrors StatusOrb's isError/isStale priority so the lifecycle pill and the status orb never contradict each other for the same chapter.

notes: 2026-07-10: fixes a bug where a chapter row could show a Cast/Rendered text pill while its StatusOrb showed red-error or amber-stale for the same chapter. Every consumer (AssemblyChapterPicker, ChapterTable, useChapterText, PublishStage, useBookData) was updated for the two new states.

frontend/src/pages/Book/useBookData.ts.purpose: Loads and manages all book-level data and actions, publishes via context
notes: 2026-07-09: context value gained hasRendered/hasUnrendered booleans; totalPredicted may now be null when no calibrated_cps is available (was previously always a number). totalRuntime/totalPredicted/hasRendered/hasUnrendered are all derived from a memoized chapterLifecycleMap (chapter.id -> deriveChapterLifecycle(chapter)) rather than ad hoc status checks -- totalRuntime sums Rendered/Cast chapters' audio_length_seconds; totalPredicted sums Rendered audio plus a char_count/calibratedCps estimate for Cast/Ready/Draft chapters.

2026-07-10 (Stale/Error lifecycle fix): totalRuntime/totalPredicted/hasRendered no longer key off a fixed list of lifecycle values (which would silently drop Stale/Error chapters to zero). Added hasRenderedAudioAsset(chapter) (audio_status==='\''done'\'' || has_wav || has_mp3 || has_m4a) used alongside the '\''Cast'\'' lifecycle check, so a chapter with a real audio asset still contributes its actual duration to the totals even when its lifecycle now reads Stale or Error; chapters with no audio asset fall back to the char-count estimate.
